story.titleZh: 美国大奖赛竞争开放 法拉利红牛梅赛德斯各有强弱
story.summaryZh: 根据奥斯汀开局表现，F1美国大奖赛可能演变为多支车队争胜，法拉利、红牛和梅赛德斯单圈差距不到0.2秒，但各自在不同路段有强有弱。
story.originalTitle: F1's wide-open US GP fight explained
story.summaryEn: Based on how the top teams have started at Austin, F1's United States Grand Prix looks poised to be a multi-team fight for victory, with Ferrari, Red Bull and Mercedes separated by less than two tenths on single-lap pace but each strong and weak in different parts of the track.
detailZh: 根据各顶尖车队在奥斯汀的开局表现，F1美国大奖赛看起来将是一场多支车队争夺胜利的较量。
以下是关于竞争格局的早期线索，单圈速度与长距离速度的趋势呈现出非常不同的画面。
领先赛车各有不同强项，加上奥斯汀赛道弯道速度范围很广、考验赛车各个方面，这意味着在单圈速度上相差不到0.2秒的法拉利、红牛和梅赛德斯，都在赛道的不同路段各有出色和挣扎之处。
领跑者夏尔·勒克莱尔在慢弯最强。他在1号弯保持了最高的最低速度，在12号弯追平了基米·安东内利的最佳值，并在11号发夹弯晚刹车且没有影响出弯。他往往是最早重新踩下油门的车手。
在高速路段，勒克莱尔在6-7号弯最快，在马克斯·维斯塔潘收油的地方保持了部分油门——不过，快速弯中的情况有时会因能量部署的差异而变得模糊。和往常一样，法拉利在直道上损失了显著的时间——相对于维斯塔潘刚刚超过0.6秒。
维斯塔潘的红牛在直道上非常强大，一旦速度稳定下来，比勒克莱尔快了约0.6秒，相比梅赛德斯也快了略多于0.1秒。这一特性也让他在起跑/终点直道上的单圈开局很强。他在刹车方面全力投入，制动力很强，但在慢弯出弯时往往更晚给油，这种做法在20号弯得到了回报，他在那里出弯很强。
对维斯塔潘来说，红牛最欠缺的地方在相当不错的一天之后变得很明显，这让这位四届F1世界冠军寻求更精细的平衡，而非任何 drastic 的改动。
当被 The Race 问及是否有突出的领域需要在一夜之间改进时，红牛技术总监皮埃尔·瓦什的判断是：“目前我们显然专注于低速性能。”
“低速对我们来说是关键。”
前面提到的维斯塔潘偏好稍早但更重地刹车，以优先保证良好出弯，这一点在整圈中都很明显，但除了20号弯之外，由于红牛赛车似乎缺乏旋转，这并没有真正体现在圈速上。
维斯塔潘的1号弯是前三名中最差的。尽管他刹车最早，但回到全油门却最慢——因为他需要处理一些车轮打滑——并且从比勒克莱尔快略超过0.1秒变成了落后0.25秒。
12号弯是他的另一个大损失，又大约0.2秒。尽管再次刹车更早，维斯塔潘在最初开始打方向入弯时没有得到他需要的响应，跑得稍微偏深，使他的最低速度比勒克莱尔和安东内利低了10公里/小时。
红牛赛车在这里的刹车区遇到颠簸时可能不够服帖，这导致维斯塔潘刹车稍早，入弯时不够凌厉或自信，出弯也不够稳定。
“找到正确的平衡比预期更困难，”瓦赫承认。
安东内利的梅赛德斯赛车表现更为均衡：直道上比法拉利快，但未达到红牛水平，不过在接近发夹弯时展现出良好速度。这可能反映了部署策略上的差异。
他在8-9号弯、15号弯和12号弯表现强劲，但在几个弯角的出弯处有所损失。
迈凯伦的单圈速度在成绩表上也毫无亮点，兰多·诺里斯是其二练中较快的车手，但落后榜首1.082秒。不过，这个圈速是用硬胎做出的，因为他不得不中止了两次排位模拟圈。
第一次是因为在9号弯弯心出现打滑，可能是受到前方乔治·拉塞尔的梅赛德斯赛车造成的乱流影响。他的第二圈使用软胎倍耐力，此时已过最佳状态，在15号弯锁死后被放弃。
迈凯伦首席技术官罗布·马歇尔表示：“我们在二练中也做出了紫色（最快赛段成绩），只是没能完成那一圈。在犯错之前，那一圈是有竞争力的。”
“从这里往前看，我们真的必须相当乐观。”
他做出这个第一赛段时间时，这是当时最快的第一赛段时间，尽管后来被维斯塔潘超越，但只差了0.015秒——而且这比法拉利或梅赛德斯取得的任何成绩都要快。
从原始数据来看，诺里斯的迈凯伦在第二次练习赛的长距离平均圈速上最快，但由于多种原因，情况令人困惑。
交通状况影响了几位车手的长距离测试，而且三种轮胎配方都被使用过，因此很难将诺里斯用耐用硬胎跑出的九圈与维斯塔潘用软胎跑出的十一圈进行对比。
但诺里斯强劲的长距离表现印证了迈凯伦比第二次练习赛成绩所显示的更强大。
倍耐力预计硬胎“在决定比赛策略方面只会发挥有限的作用”，最有可能采用软胎和中性胎的一停策略。
维斯塔潘的软胎表现令人印象深刻地出色，圈速稳定，相比勒克莱尔的轮胎衰减更小。
队友伊萨克·哈贾尔显然没有那么适应。他全天都在与过热的前胎作斗争；谈到自己的软胎圈时，他说“简直就是一场灾难”。
“车根本没法开，前部严重失去抓地力。我们需要查一查，因为这不正常，为什么一圈之内就有这么大的衰减。”
哈贾尔表示，他的轮胎在高速弯里“完全废了”。红牛的瓦赫说，这是造成差异的关键，他表示哈贾尔和维斯塔潘在调校上差距不大。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿、乔治·拉塞尔、奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和哈贾尔似乎都在周末开始时比各自队友慢了一步。
汉密尔顿表示，他“在调校上尝试了不同方向，但我在车里不舒服，尤其是在颠簸路段”，而皮亚斯特里用软胎的长距离节奏似乎急剧下滑。
随着各车队在一夜之间吸取经验并调整调校和能量部署模式，这一局面可能会改变，但目前四支车队看起来都在奥斯汀的争夺行列中。
detailEn: Formula 1's United States Grand Prix looks poised to be a multi-team fight for victory based on how the top four teams have started at Austin.
Here are the early clues about the pecking order, with single-lap and long-run pace trends painting very different pictures.

The combination of the varying strengths of the leading cars and the wide range of corner speeds of the Austin circuit that tests every facet of a car means that Ferrari, Red Bull and Mercedes, which were separated by less than two tenths on single-lap pace, all excelled and struggled at different parts of the track.

Pacesetter Charles Leclerc was strongest in the slow corners. He carried the highest minimum speed at Turn 1, matched Kimi Antonelli's best at Turn 12, and braked late for the Turn 11 hairpin without compromising his exit. He was often first back on the throttle.

In the high-speed sections, Leclerc was quickest through Turns 6-7, keeping part-throttle where Max Verstappen lifted - however, at times the picture in the fast corners was muddied by deployment variations. As always, the Ferrari lost significant time on the straights - just over six tenths relative to Verstappen.

Verstappen's Red Bull was mighty on the straights, gaining around six tenths on Leclerc once the speeds had settled, and a little over a tenth compared to the Mercedes. That characteristic also gave him a strong start to the lap down the start/finish straight. He was committed on the brakes in terms of stopping power, but was often later on the throttle at slow-corner exits, with that approach paying off at Turn 20, where he had a strong exit.
Where Red Bull is lacking most for Verstappen was obvious after a pretty good day left the four-time F1 world champion seeking a finer balance rather than anything drastic.

"It's clearly the low-speed performance that we are focused on at the moment," was Red Bull technical director Pierre Wache's verdict when asked by The Race if there was a standout area to improve overnight.
"Low speed is the key for us."

That aforementioned Verstappen preference for braking slightly earlier, but harder, to prioritise a good exit was clear throughout the lap but, other than at Turn 20, it did not really manifest in laptime due to the Red Bull seemingly lacking rotation.

Verstappen's Turn 1 was the worst of the top three. Despite braking earliest he was slowest back to full throttle - due to some wheelspin he had to manage - and swung from just over a tenth up on Leclerc to 0.25s behind.

Turn 12 was his other big loss, around 0.2s again. Despite again braking earlier, Verstappen did not have the response he needed when he initially started applying steering lock into the corner and ran a little deep, dropping his minimum speed 10km/h below Leclerc's and Antonelli's.

It's possible the Red Bull is not quite as compliant on the bumps in the braking zones here, which is contributing to Verstappen braking slightly earlier and not being as attacking or as confident on entry, or as steady on exit.
"Finding the right balance was more difficult than expected," Wache admitted.

Antonelli's Mercedes had a more balanced performance profile: quicker on the straights than the Ferrari but not at Red Bull level, but showing good speed on the approach to the hairpin. Potentially, that reflected differences in deployment.
He was strong in Turns 8-9, Turn 15 and Turn 12, but did lose out in several corners on the exits.

McLaren's single-lap pace also looked nowhere on the timesheets, with Lando Norris the faster of its drivers in FP2 but 1.082s off the pace. However, this time was set on hards as he had to abort both of his qualifying simulation laps.

The first was because of a snap mid-corner at Turn 9, possibly the result of running in turbulent air caused by George Russell's Mercedes ahead. His second lap, on soft Pirellis now past their best, was abandoned after a lockup at Turn 15.

"We set a purple [fastest sector time] in FP2 as well, we just didn't finish the lap," said McLaren chief technical officer Rob Marshall. "It was a competitive lap up until the point where we made a mistake.
"Going forward from here we've got to be quite optimistic really."
That first sector time was the fastest at the time he set it, and although it was eclipsed by Verstappen that was only by 0.015s - and it was faster than anything achieved by Ferrari or Mercedes.
On the raw numbers, Norris's McLaren was fastest on the long-run averages in FP2, but it's a confusing picture for a number of reasons.

Traffic affected a number of drivers' long runs and all three tyre compounds were used, so it's tricky to compare a nine-lap Norris run on durable hards to Verstappen's 11-lap soft-tyre run, for example.
But Norris's strong long run backs up McLaren looking stronger than the FP2 result suggested.
Pirelli expects the hard tyre to "play only a limited role in defining race strategies", with a one-stop using the softs and mediums most likely.
Verstappen's soft tyres held up impressively well with consistent laptimes and less of a drop-off compared to Leclerc's.
Team-mate Isack Hadjar was clearly not as comfortable. He struggled with overheating front tyres all day; "it's just a disaster" he said of his soft tyre lap.
"It was just undriveable, and I was losing the front end massively. We need to have a look because that's not normal, why there is so much deg on one lap."
Hadjar said his tyres were "completely killed" in the high-speed corners. Red Bull's Wache said this was key to the difference as he said Hadjar and Verstappen weren't far apart on set-up.
Lewis Hamilton, George Russell, Oscar Piastri and Hadjar all appear to have started the weekend a step behind their respective team-mates.

Hamilton said he "tried a different direction with the set-up, but I wasn't comfortable in the car, especially over the bumps", while Piastri's long run pace on the softs appeared to sharply tail off.
That picture may alter as teams learn overnight lessons and change set-up and deployment patterns, but right now all four teams look like they are in the hunt at Austin.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔在慢弯最强：1号弯最低速度最高，12号弯与安东内利的最佳值持平，11号发夹弯刹车晚且未影响出弯。
勒克莱尔在6至7号弯的高速路段最快，在马克斯·维斯塔潘收油处保持部分油门。
法拉利在直道上相对维斯塔潘损失超过0.6秒。
keyPointsEn: Leclerc was strongest in the slow corners: he carried the highest minimum speed at Turn 1, matched Antonelli's best at Turn 12, and braked late for the Turn 11 hairpin without compromising his exit.
Leclerc was quickest through the high-speed Turns 6-7, keeping part-throttle where Max Verstappen lifted.
Ferrari lost just over six tenths relative to Verstappen on the straights.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
